persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrī2 jaya bhūpatīndra malaa mahārājādhirāja sana

date.as_written: samvat 824 vaiśāṣa śukla pakṣa tṛtīyā kuhnu

purpose: Commemorating/performing the siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña and galālacchapratiṣṭhā
notes: The colophon commemorates the day on which King Jayabhūpatīndramalla of Bhaktapur performed a Siddhāgni Ayutāhuti sacrifice and Galālacchā consecration.
